title: The Compute ICE-AGE: OPAL ONE, Continuity That Persists While Reasoning Is Idle
abstract: arXiv:2602.16736v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Compute ICE-AGE separates persistent application memory from probabilistic reasoning. We present OPAL, a CPU-resident C++17 graph engine that preserves record identities, relationships, and accepted numerical state between reasoning sessions. Applications evolve that state through defined updates, save canonical checkpoints, and recover continuity after restart. Bounded Local Generator Classes (BLGC) provide the mathematical foundation for this bounded local evolution.   On Apple Silicon M2 Pro hardware, the current-engine resident-update P50 measured 0.083 microseconds at 100,000, 1,000,000, and 5,000,000 retained Atomic Memory Vertices (AMVs). A same-session 1M-5M-1M sequence reproduced that median using one frozen binary and 1,024 prepared targets, with every process passing its correctness checks. These measurements cover complete resident-update calls, including validation, indexed lookup, and numerical state mutation.

translated_title: 计算ICE-AGE：OPAL ONE，推理空闲时依然延续的持久连续性
translated_abstract: 摘要：计算ICE-AGE将持久应用内存与概率推理相分离。我们提出OPAL，一个驻留于CPU的C++17图引擎，它能在推理会话之间保留记录身份、关系以及已接受的数值状态。应用程序通过定义好的更新来演化该状态，保存规范化检查点，并在重启后恢复连续性。有界局部生成器类（BLGC）为这种有界局部演化提供了数学基础。在Apple Silicon M2 Pro硬件上，当前引擎的驻留更新P50中位数在保留100,000、1,000,000和5,000,000个原子内存顶点（AMV）时均测得0.083微秒。同一会话内1M-5M-1M的序列在使用单个冻结二进制文件和1,024个预备目标的情况下复现了该中位数，且每个进程都通过了正确性检查。这些测量涵盖了完整的驻留更新调用，包括验证、索引查找和数值状态变更。
tldr: OPAL是一个驻留CPU的C++17图引擎，能在推理会话之间持久保留记录身份、关系与数值状态，并在高达500万原子内存顶点规模下实现0.083微秒的驻留更新中位延迟。
